decisions.reason: As a flagship product line close to the core software business and publicly tied to the firm's digital direction, management is very likely to continue backing it and view any remaining weaknesses as solvable through further development.

Because the education institute builds on established training capabilities and customer relationships, a growing firm with broad offerings is inclined to retain it unless it clearly distracts from core priorities.

The analytics dashboard fits the firm's announced move toward more digital and efficiently managed practices, so prior development effort and strategic fit make continued commitment more likely than withdrawal.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and commercially central, which makes management reluctant to abandon it after investing in packaging and market positioning.

The job and practice listing portal is comparatively distant from the firm's core software and support activities and was less visibly committed, so management is more willing to reallocate resources away from it despite some sunk cost.
